drafts_today.topic: Trail Bay Centre: two dates, Fri Nov 27 and Sun Nov 29
drafts_today.text:
Sechelt friends: you get two chances now.

Trail Bay Centre
Fri Nov 27, 11 to 4
Sun Nov 29

Come feel the RIMAN textures on your hands, ask me anything about skin after 40, and guess how many candies are in the tub.

Which day works for you?
drafts_today.picture_tip: Your candy tub front and centre on the booth table with 3-4 RIMAN jars behind it, a handwritten card 'Fri Nov 27 + Sun Nov 29'. Daylight from the mall windows.
drafts_today.video_tip: 8-10s clip: shake the candy tub to camera, set it down beside your products, tap the date card. On-screen: 'Trail Bay. Nov 27 + 29. Guess the candies.'

drafts_today.topic: Confession myth-bust: serum on a wet face
drafts_today.text:
Confession: for years I put serum on while my face was still wet from washing.

Now I pat dry first, then:
1. Booster, wait
2. Serum, let it dry
3. Booster again
4. Cream

Each layer dries before the next. Slower, and my skin feels so much better.

Save this for tonight.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Four-product flat lay on a folded dry face cloth: Dermatology Booster EX, Serum EX, Booster again, Dermatology Cream with spatula, numbered 1-4 on sticky notes.
drafts_today.video_tip: 12-15s: pat face dry with a towel, spray Booster and hold still (on-screen 'wait'), massage Serum, spray Booster, scoop Cream with the spatula. Text: 'Dry skin first. Every layer dries.'

drafts_today.topic: Cold air outside, dry heat inside: winter shower habit
drafts_today.text:
Cold air outside. Dry heat inside.

My shins feel it before my face does.

The habit that helps:
1. Warm shower, not hot
2. Gentle body wash
3. Body cream fresh out of the shower, massaged in circles

I use botalab Suamel for both.

Where does winter hit you first?
drafts_today.picture_tip: Suamel Nourishing Body Wash and Body Cream on the edge of the tub with a folded towel and a steamy (not wet-lens) mirror behind.
drafts_today.video_tip: 8-10s: pump the body wash into your hand, cut to massaging Body Cream into a shin in circles. On-screen: 'Shins first. Every winter.'
